 Victoria E. Freile, New York Connect Team Updated Wed, November 11, 2026 at 10:15 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Is Veterans Day a federal holiday? What's open and closed on Nov. 11, 2026 Veterans Day is an annual November holiday honoring all men and women who have served in the U.S. military, in wartime and peacetime.
 The federal holiday is observed with parades, memorial services and other events recognizing veterans and their service. Many businesses also offer special discounts and deals for veterans as a way to show their appreciation.
 Here's what to know about Veterans Day in 2026, including when it falls and what businesses and government offices will be open or closed.
 When is Veterans Day in 2026?
 Veterans Day is observed annually on Nov. 11, regardless of the day of the week. In 2026, the holiday falls on a Wednesday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It is one of 11 federal holidays recognized by the U.S. government.
 What's open and closed on Veterans Day 2026?
 Federal government offices, federal courts and post offices generally close for Veterans Day.
 Most grocery stores, restaurants, retailers and other private businesses remain open, though operating hours may vary by location.
 The New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq are expected to operate during their regular trading hours.
 School schedules also vary by district. Some schools and colleges observe the holiday and close, while others remain open.
 Are banks open on Veterans Day?
 No. Banks generally close on Veterans Day because it is a federal holiday. Bank ATMs and online and mobile banking services typically remain available.
 What federal holidays remain in 2026?
 Following Veterans Day, the remaining federal holidays in 2026 include:
 Advertisement Advertisement Thanksgiving Day, Nov. 26
 Christmas Day, Dec. 25
